The '''Hitaka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hitaka]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' originally placed the Hitaka system in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], in grid square M-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> This was later corrected by [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the Hitaka system in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in grid square M-6.<ref name="EAOC" />

Despite this however, maps of ''The Essential Atlas'' and ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' showed the Hitaka system in the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
